QUOTE: "Is it retry logic? No. Neither call is retried because of a failure. The first call always runs, and it is a size query rather than an attempt that failed. The second call is not repeated if it fails."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer concludes it is a size query (two-phase sized-buffer) rather than retry-on-failure, with exactly one second call that is not repeated; the lack of backoff or delay is only implicit.
